# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Thomas, Saying 48

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** GTH 048
**Total Disagreements:** 2

---

## Disagreement 1 — "this one house" vs. "the same house"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "this one house"
**PNEUMA:** "the same house"
**Issue:** The Coptic has the demonstrative; "this one house" preserves its specificity. "The same house" is explanatory.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "This one house" retained.

---

## Disagreement 2 — "move away" vs. "get out of the way"

**Verse:** v.1
**EMET/LOGOS:** "move away"
**PNEUMA:** "get out of the way"
**Issue:** *Parage* = to pass away/move; the same verb used in Sayings 11 and 42. Consistent rendering is important for recognizing the verbal echo.
**Resolution (SOPHIA):** "Move away" retained for verbal consistency.

---
